payout_quote: Official fivesurveys.com headline: 'FiveSurveys: Earn $5 for Every 5 Surveys You Complete' — '5 Completed surveys means $5 on your balance. Redeem your accumulated money for cash, gift cards, or exciting prizes.' Cash withdrawals via PayPal.
timing: $5 is added to your balance on completing 5 surveys; redemption timing after that is via PayPal/gift cards.
biggest_catch: The $5 only arrives after 5 FULL completed surveys — partial surveys and screen-outs don't count, so reaching the first $5 can take a while.
catches: Requires 5 full completed surveys for the $5 — disqualifications and half-surveys don't count toward the 5.
Per-survey effective pay is $1, and surveys take time — low hourly rate.
Redemption options are PayPal cash or gift cards; exact payout processing time not stated on the pages reviewed.
steps: Go to https://www.fivesurveys.com/ and sign up free.
Take surveys; each full completion counts toward the 5.
Once 5 surveys are completed, $5 is added to your balance.
Redeem your balance for PayPal cash or gift cards.
eligibility: Free signup; survey availability varies by profile.
